about_the_game:
Game Genres

  • Action Rogue-lite

  • Horror Elements

  • Narrative Dialogue

  • 2D Side-scrolling Platformer

Game Features

  • Unsettling Atmosphere Throughout

The game adopts a horror presentation style, using lighting, sound effects, and visual design to create a strong sense of unease, making every exploration filled with tension.

  • Fast-paced and Varied Combat

In addition to basic movement, jumping, climbing, and combos, the game introduces a parry and counterattack system. By performing precise blocks, players can accumulate energy to unleash powerful skills. After each boss defeat, new skills or weapons are unlocked, allowing continuous evolution of your combat style.

  • Attribute Growth in Your Control

Instead of a traditional linear leveling system, the game lets you enhance abilities by collecting souls. Depending on the current map and resources, you can freely choose whether to grow stronger or face the boss head-on for a greater challenge — the difficulty is yours to define.

  • Semi-linear Random Maps – A New Journey Each Time

Each soul-collecting level is procedurally built from pre-designed rooms. Though forward-moving by design, the map includes optional branches for exploration, making each run a unique and engaging adventure.

  • Diverse Bosses, Unique Combat Mechanics

Each boss features distinct attack patterns and skill systems. Mastering the rhythm of blocking, countering, and skill use is the key to victory and earning your rightful rewards.

Story Background

Set in the world of Fuel, the story unfolds in a future where a biological experiment on the moon goes wrong. The creature mutates uncontrollably, its flesh expanding endlessly, consuming most of the lunar surface and causing local lifeforms to transform into aggressive monsters.

Returning from a long journey, a mechanical rabbit finds its homeland in ruins and chooses to join forces with the remaining scientists to reclaim the devoured moon, step by step...

name: soul balance

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3+, AMD Ryzen 3+
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000+
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • VR Support: Not Supported

short_description: Soul Balance is a 2D hand-drawn action rogue-like that combines horror presentation with a dynamic skill growth system. Take on the role of a mechanical rabbit battling through a monster-ravaged world, enhancing your abilities, and facing off in deadly encounters against mutated former allies.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, German, Russian, Japanese, Thai, Korean
